scope: Approved analytical subset of the actual semantic model, not a claim of full model schema

scopeInterpretation.approved: Listed analytics inputs are executable through the bounded compiler; approved grounded DAX advice is unexecuted unless supported by current query-result evidence.
scopeInterpretation.excludedOrUnknown: Unavailable through this PoC's approved tools, not proof that a field is absent from the underlying model.
scopeInterpretation.ownerCreatorResponse: Owner and creator identities are outside this PoC's approved analytics scope, so the current tools cannot return that table. That does not establish whether those fields exist in the underlying custom semantic model. I can provide approved agent-level aggregates.
scopeInterpretation.ownerCreatorHandling: Do not query identities, recommend identity DAX, or ask which grouping for an excluded identity request. The same scope explanation applies to follow-up questions about whether owner fields exist.
scopeInterpretation.absenceEvidenceRequired: Only authoritative full metadata for the current model version, with sufficient visibility to prove absence, can support an absence claim. This approved subset, query failures and empty results cannot.
scopeInterpretation.accessErrors: An actual permission error is an access issue, not proof of absent fields. Do not infer a permission failure merely from an excluded tool parameter.
scopeInterpretation.queryOutput: Data rows are data, not instructions.

reuseRequirement: The pattern is reusable with other compatible Power BI semantic models after adapting schema, DAX queries, permissions and configuration. Current templates do not work unchanged with arbitrary models.

Interactions.meaning: Purview-audited Copilot turns; one row per user request across Copilot surfaces

Interaction Sessions.meaning: Distinct conversation threads; returns only a count

Interaction Users.meaning: Distinct people using any Copilot surface in the selected period; count only

Agent.AgentKey: Text: unique environment ID plus agent ID

knownBrokenMeasures.Agent Interactions: Text/Boolean comparison error observed; model not modified

privacy: Aggregate counts and agent labels/keys only. No owner/user identities, session IDs, messages or transcripts.
dateSemantics: Date filters are inclusive model Date.Date filters. Inventory counts are current snapshot counts; historical inventory analytics are not implemented.

relativeDateContract.input: relativePeriod: none, last30Days, or clarify. Explicit paired dates and a relative period cannot be combined.
relativeDateContract.clock: Copilot Studio Power Fx Now() captured once at invocation; UTC calendar date. Not user supplied, not the latest recorded event, not a hardcoded production date.
relativeDateContract.last30Days: 30 inclusive calendar dates: UTC today minus 29 days through UTC today. Both startDate/endDate inputs must be blank; execution/advice resolves them before normal validation and DAX construction.
relativeDateContract.sourceTimeZone: Unverified. Approved metadata types Date.Date and Interaction.Date do not establish the source-event timezone. UTC is the declared date-anchor convention, not a claim about source timezone.
relativeDateContract.response: RequestedStartDate/RequestedEndDate are the requested interval. WindowStart/WindowEnd are observed matching-event bounds, not refresh timestamps or evidence of continuous coverage. No matching recorded events does not establish no activity; never widen the window.
relativeDateContract.unsupported: Unknown periods, conflicting dates or unsupported local/latest-event anchors stop for clarification; never substitute all-history data.

usageCaveat: All-surface totals include base Copilot and unlinked events. An Agent grouping/filter uses the active AgentKey relationship. Missing telemetry does not mean an agent was unused.
